highlights: Visitor and Volunteer Policy with sign-in and sign-out badge procedures
Designated Safeguarding Leads for student welfare and safety concerns
Background checks and character verifications for volunteers and staff
safety.policy_summary: PBISS takes its responsibility to protect and safeguard the welfare of children and young people seriously, operating under the principle that the welfare of the child is paramount. The school enforces strict visitor and volunteer procedures requiring registration, sign-in processes, and background suitability checks, alongside an annually reviewed Child Protection Policy.
